documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Divestment Of Stake In A Step-Down Subsidiary By Trancemarine And Confreight Logistics Private Limited A Subsidiary Of The Company

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On 21 September 2026 -Scheme Of Arrangement Between Dalmia Bharat Refractories Limited ('Demerged Company') And Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd ('Resulting Company')

analysis.summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance with consolidated revenue of INR 1,432 Crores and EBITDA of INR 313 Crores. Management announced strategic initiatives including carbon nanotube and super speciality carbon black manufacturing facilities, alongside progress in new energy materials such as anode and LFP cathode capacity. The company's turnaround of Birla Tyres continues with modernization and shifting towards OTR and PCR production. Furthermore, capital allocation remains disciplined with self-funded capex across brownfield and greenfield expansions. Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd reported its Q1FY27 financial results, recording consolidated revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: Birla Tyres aims to reach INR 3,000 Crores of top line in the next 4 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: We will continue this trajectory and in next 4 years to 5 years the target is to reach INR3,000 Crores of top line in Birla tyres.

guidance.claim: The company has committed to double its profit after tax from INR 555 crores in FY25 to INR 1,100 plus crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: I have given a guidance that FY25 we had a PAT of INR 555 crores. We have committed to double this PAT in next three years in FY28 to INR 1,100 plus crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise from approximately 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise from around 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer engagements with leading Indian and global cell manufacturers have intensified significantly for the LFP platform.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer engagements have intensified significantly with leading Indian as well as global cell manufacturers, and the response has been strongly encouraging.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned a capex of approximately INR 70 Crores for a 200 MTPA carbon nanotube manufacturing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

capex_expansion.claim: Himadri is converting 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity with a capex of INR 170 Crores to enter Super Speciality Carbon Black.
capex_expansion.quote: We are converting 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity with a capex of INR170 Crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The initial 2,000 MTPA LFP capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Total announced capex is around INR 2,000 Crores, which includes INR 1,125 Crores for LFP and INR 368 Crores announced yesterday.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, total capex we have announced is around INR2,000 Crores, INR1,125 Crores for LFP, INR368 Crores announced yesterday.

capex_expansion.claim: The company reported total capex of Rs. 1,125 Cr for LFP Speciality Chemicals and Carbon Nano Tube investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex Rs. 1,125 Cr Rs. 248 Cr Rs. 70 Cr Rs. 170 Cr

capex_expansion.claim: The company established a 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry, West Bengal.
capex_expansion.quote: Established a 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry, West Bengal

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum on April 23, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: On 23rd April 2026, we successfully commissioned operation at our first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry, West Bengal with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum, marking a pivotal step in our entry into lithium-ion battery materials value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The execution of Phase 1 of the lithium-ion phosphate cathode active material project targeting 40,000 metric tons per annum is on track.
capex_expansion.quote: Execution of Phase 1 of our lithium-ion phosphate cathode active material project, which envisages a total capacity of 40,000 metric tons per annum is on track.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we successfully commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry, taking our total speciality carbon black capacity to 130,000 metric tons per annum and our overall carbon black capacity to 250,000 metric ton per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and is expected to commission in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, our anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and expected to commission in Q2 FY27, helping address a significant import dependency in India.

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone revenue for the quarter stood at INR 1,274 Crores with an EBITDA margin of 24%.
margins_costs.quote: Our stand-alone revenue for the quarter stood at INR1,274 Crores as compared to INR1,100 Crores a year ago, an increase of 16%. Our EBITDA stood at INR301 Crores as compared to INR234 Crores a year ago with a growth rate of 29% and margin of 24%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA stood at INR 1,006 crores and profit after tax reached INR 755 crores for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, EBITDA stood at INR 1,006 crores, PBT at INR1,001 crores and Profit after Tax at INR 755 crores, reflecting the strength of our value-added portfolio, operational discipline and consistent focus on in-house innovation.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates across a product portfolio of more than 70 speciality grades with 250,000 metric ton capacity, including 130,000 tons of speciality carbon black capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: With 250,000 metric ton capacity, including 130,000 tons of speciality carbon black capacity, we operate across a product portfolio of more than 70 speciality grades.

orders_capacity.claim: The world's largest single location fully integrated carbon complex has 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: We operate the world's largest single location fully integrated carbon complex, with 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Himadri operates 8 zero discharge plants across India and China.
orders_capacity.quote: 8 zero discharge plants across India & China

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds a 65% domestic market share in coal tar pitch.
The company maintains 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity

capital_allocation.claim: The capex program is entirely self-funded and deliberately calibrated between brownfield expansions and greenfield investments.
capital_allocation.quote: The capex program is thoughtfully structured to balance scale with efficiency. It is entirely self-funded and deliberately calibrated between brownfield expansions, which enhance asset productivity and greenfield investments, where we are building new capabilities from the ground up.

capital_allocation.claim: Himadri made a strategic investment in IBC to strengthen its participation in the global battery value chain with a 19.44% stake.
capital_allocation.quote: Himadri made a strategic investment in IBC to strengthen its participation in the global battery value chain (19.44% stake)

capital_allocation.claim: Himadri holds a 40% stake in Invati Creations.
The company held a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 31st March 2026, we hold a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores, which gives us ample flexibilities to pursue growth opportunities while maintaining a prudent approach to capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Because of huge volatility in the currency, foreign exchange losses occurred.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, there is no change in the hedging policy because of the huge volatility in the currency, this happened.

management_commitments.claim: The 200 MTPA carbon nanotube manufacturing facility is targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

management_commitments.claim: Initial 2,000 MTPA capacity for LFP cathode chemistry is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28, paving the way for its planned entry into EV and SUV tyre segments.

management_commitments.claim: Full commissioning of forward integration into anthraquinone and carbazole with a total capacity of 5,300 MTPA is targeted by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our forward integration into anthraquinone and carbazole with a total capacity of 5,300 MTPA is progressing well with full commissioning targeted by FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial operations for the India Gigafactory are on track for Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial operations for India Gigafactory on track for Q4FY27

management_commitments.claim: Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility commissioning is targeted by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: PCR facility commissioning targeted by FY28

management_commitments.claim: The first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons for the LFP cathode project is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As part of this phased execution, the first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: FY29 is envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations of the LFP cathode active material project.
management_commitments.quote: The balance Phase 1 capacity will be progressively brought onstream over the subsequent 12 months, closely aligned with customer approvals and demand visibility, with FY29 envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations.

management_commitments.claim: Sicona's capacity expansion is currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: During the year, Sicona has achieved important milestones at pilot scale level, with further capacity expansion currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27, supporting intensified engagement with global cell manufacturers across multiple stages of sample approvals.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next 12 to 24 months, capacity utilization for Birla Tyres will be progressively enhanced.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 12 to 24 months, we will be progressively enhance our capacity utilization, supported by robust pipeline of new product launches across agriculture, mining and commercial vehicle segments.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
